neighbours.label: The completing word of a fixed formulaic phrase whose second half is set by convention (Running head:, daytime sleepiness, something to do, Just for today): the word that closes a stock formula
fire:
Department of Psychology, Ohio State University
Running head: SLEEP AND MEMORY CONSOLIDATION

Submitted for PSY 301.
Running head: SOCIAL MEDIA AND SELF-ESTEEM
Narcolepsy usually begins with excessive daytime sleepiness in adolescence.
Shift workers often report excessive daytime sleepiness and poor mood.
Bored teenagers who have nothing to do often end up in trouble.
On rainy days the children always need something to do indoors.
Her recovery group repeats the same promise: just for today, I will not drink.

Prepared for Dr. Lee's seminar.
Running head: WORKING MEMORY IN CHILDREN

Her recovery group repeats the same promise every morning at the church.

Prepared for Dr. Lee's seminar.
